title: Credit Controller
description:
Reed Accountancy are currently partnered with an established client in the Crawley area who are seeking a dedicated Credit Controller to manage all aspects of credit control for their UK and European entities. This role requires maintaining high standards and adhering to agreed timescales, ensuring the financial integrity of our sales ledger and customer credit accounts.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Maintain the sales ledger and customer credit accounts to ensure timely payment against agreed credit terms.
- Assign credit terms to new customer accounts, ensuring limits are in line with company policy.
- Maintain effective customer relationships to ensure prompt payment and reduce late payments and bad debts.
- Manage the customer 'stop-list' and liaise with the Sales teams and customers.
- Handle reconciliation and posting of receipts for the UK and Europe.
- Process month-end closure procedures and credit-card payments over the telephone.
- Manage customer correspondence related to invoicing, statements, and requests for payment.
- Provide additional administrative support within the Finance team as needed.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to work independently.
- Proven ability to work under pressure in a busy environment.
- Strong team spirit and a positive working environment advocate.
- Proactive in recommending improvements and new ideas to the Finance Manager.
- Effective communicator across various levels of the organisation, ensuring professionalism.
- Open to feedback and coaching, with a willingness to discuss and agree on targets and development needs.
- High level of Computer literacy - Sage and SAP highly desirable.

An excellent opportunity to join this ever growing client so don't delay apply now!

title: Customer Service Advisor - immediate start
description:
Customer Contact Executive

Location: Crawley
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am - 5:00pm (Full Time, Onsite)
Pay: 12.83 per hour
Contract: Temp to Perm

Join a Busy Customer Contact Team

Are you confident on the phone and enjoy helping customers? We're looking for a proactive and personable Customer Contact Executive to join a growing team in Crawley.

This is a fast-paced role where you'll spend a large proportion of your day speaking with customers and third parties over the phone, gathering information, resolving queries and ensuring cases continue to progress smoothly. If you thrive in a customer-focused environment and enjoy building rapport with people, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role

As a Customer Contact Executive, you'll be responsible for managing a high volume of inbound and outbound calls, supporting customers throughout their journey and ensuring all information is accurately captured and recorded.

Key Responsibilities
Customer Contact & Case Progression
- Make a high volume of outbound calls to customers and third parties to obtain information and progress cases.
- Handle inbound customer enquiries professionally and efficiently.
- Build rapport with customers whilst delivering an excellent customer experience.
- Take ownership of customer queries and work proactively towards resolution.
- Keep customers informed with regular updates throughout the process.
- Communicate via telephone, email, text and other channels where required.

Call Handling & Information Gathering
- Obtain and verify important information from customers and third parties.
- Ask relevant questions to accurately assess each case.
- Ensure all conversations are handled professionally, empathetically and in line with company procedures.
- Manage follow-up calls and ongoing customer contact to ensure cases progress without delay.

Record Keeping & Administration
- Accurately update customer records following every interaction.
- Log call outcomes and maintain clear case notes on internal systems.
- Ensure customer information is recorded correctly and kept up to date.
- Complete any supporting administration associated with customer cases.

Team Support
- Participate in team meetings and contribute to a positive working environment.
- Work collaboratively with colleagues to deliver excellent customer outcomes.
- Support wider team activity during busy periods when required.

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience within a call centre, contact centre, customer service or telephone-based role.
- Confident speaking with customers and managing a high volume of calls.
- Excellent communication and listening skills.
- Strong customer service focus with the ability to build rapport quickly.
- Comfortable handling sensitive conversations professionally and empathetically.
- Good attention to detail and accurate data entry skills.
- Competent IT skills and confidence using multiple systems.
- Positive attitude and ability to work effectively within a fast-paced team environment.

Additional Benefits of Working Through Office Angels
- Weekly pay.
- 28 days paid annual leave (based on accrual).
- Pension scheme with employer contributions.
- Eye care vouchers and contribution towards VDU glasses where applicable.
- Dedicated consultant support throughout your assignment.
- Access to permanent opportunities and interview coaching whilst temping.

title: Internal Sales Executive
description:
Internal Sales Executive

Crawley - Hybrid after probation

Up to 30,000 + Commission + Progression

The Opportunity:

Get Recruited are working with an established and successful business that is looking to recruit a motivated and commercially minded Internal Sales Executive to join their team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, developing existing accounts and identifying new business opportunities, all from an office-based sales environment. The role offers a great mix of account management and proactive sales, making it ideal for someone who is confident speaking with customers, spotting opportunities and driving revenue without the need to be out on the road.

This would be an excellent opportunity for an Internal Sales Executive, Sales Executive, Sales Account Executive, B2 B Sales Executive, Sales Coordinator or Business Development Executive.

The Role:
- Manage and develop relationships with an existing portfolio of customers, maximising repeat business and account growth.
- Proactively identify and approach prospective customers through outbound calls, emails and targeted sales activity.
- Generate new business opportunities and build a strong pipeline of potential customers.
- Respond to incoming sales enquiries, providing product information, pricing and quotations.
- Identify opportunities to upsell and cross-sell products to existing customers.
- Build strong relationships with key decision-makers, understanding their requirements and offering suitable solutions.
- Follow up on quotations, enquiries and leads to maximise conversion rates.
- Work closely with internal teams to ensure a smooth customer experience from initial enquiry through to delivery.
- Maintain accurate customer records, sales activity and pipeline information using CRM systems.
- Work towards individual sales targets and contribute to the wider commercial objectives of the business.

The Person:
- Previous experience in internal sales, account management, sales support or a similar B2 B sales role.
- A proven ability to develop customer relationships and identify new business opportunities.
- Confidence in making outbound calls and approaching prospective customers.
- Strong communication, negotiation and customer service skills.
- A commercial mindset with the ability to spot opportunities and maximise account potential.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple customer enquiries and priorities.
- Experience preparing quotations, following up on leads and managing a sales pipeline.
- A self-motivated, positive attitude with a genuine desire to achieve results.
